checks.word_gate: Every word passes config/a1-vocabulary.json, including after the edits. Listed but moderately hard words are flagged per item (handdoek, gratis, huisarts, pinpas, tomaat); toetje and the pas/kaart double term were removed.
checks.step2_limits: Texts 51-57 words (50-80), longest sentence 10 words, exactly three questions per item on facts from three different sentences or lines, prompts at most eight words, options at most four words, explanations at most fourteen words.
checks.names: Femke, Omar, Rosa, Ivo, Dina and Sara each appear in one item; none is drawn in two pictures, so no trait lists apply.

diversity: Six information structures: a changed day with things to bring, opening hours as lines with news, a team introduction with schedule, an invitation with a deadline, a letter about a new GP, a canteen menu with prices. Set 1 (items 1-3) and set 2 (items 4-6) mix vrije-tijd, werk, wonen-buurt, gezondheid and opleiding.

media_notes.approval: Sources and briefs only; no image approved.

limitations: AI editorial review does not validate CEFR difficulty or official exam equivalence.
Rendered pictures need their own review.
Listed words such as handdoek, gratis, huisarts and pinpas are still the hardest words; learners in the first weeks may not know them without a picture or a course.
